mapper.select: SELECT wh.FAR FROM warehouse wh JOIN admin a ON wh.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id WHERE admin_id = #{admin_id}

SELECT s.FAR AS FAR , s.sector_id AS sector_id, s.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id FROM sector s WHERE s.warehouse_id = (SELECT wh.warehouse_id FROM warehouse wh JOIN admin a ON wh.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id WHERE admin_id = #{admin_id})
SELECT COUNT(user_id) FROM user WHERE admin_id = #{admin_id}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(approve_date, '%y-%m') AS month, SUM(rent_price) AS total_rent FROM rent_history WHERE status = '완료' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(approve_date, '%y-%m')
SELECT a.admin_name AS admin_name, a.phone_num AS phone_num FROM user u JOIN admin a ON u.admin_id = a.admin_id WHERE u.user_id = #{user_id}
SELECT r.sector_id AS sector_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name FROM rent_history r JOIN warehouse w ON r.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE user_id = #{user_id}

SELECT s.FAR AS FAR, s.sector_id AS sector_id, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id FROM rent_history r JOIN sector s ON s.sector_id = r.sector_id JOIN warehouse w ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE r.user_id = #{user_id}
